notes.title: The Zen Update is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42185272/586ed27b1c7c8c3ca6dd699480b39c0cb4ad9518.png[/img]

Hello Incrementalists, 

For v1.1, a new experience has been added to the final level of Increment, the "breathing orb"! Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth on a gently guided meditation with the soothing sounds and pulsing colors of the breathing orb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42185272/09bb509415260b44d665a67fd383f69a000eab16.png[/img]

If you've already completed Increment, you should be able to load directly into the final area of the game and get right into the soul-soothing, breathing action via an auto-save in Slot 1 in the hand menu!



[b][url=https://twitter.com/PilPointZero]Follow the developer on Twitter![/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/XUXy8EWnaj]Join the Increment Discord![/url][/b]

notes.title: Increment heads to TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42185272/41ecfed0d1d85219aceb1c2f19e07261ab6c88e0.png[/img]

Increment is thrilled to be picked as part of the "Selected Indie 80" at the legendary Tokyo Game Show this year - which will be held at Makuhari Messe for 4 days from September 21st (Thu) to September 24th (Sun), 2023.

Come check out Increment at our booth and pick up an exclusive pin-back button of your favorite emoji from the game!

Related Links

notes.title: Increment is now available!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=otURu663yBs;full][/previewyoutube]

Increment is now available, for free! Download the game today and enjoy the thrill of a full bodied, number increasing experience.

If you like the game, consider supporting the developer by buying some of the cosmetic DLC. Flex your love of increasing by getting a Golden Button, Silver Speedbags, or Diamond Hands.

Join the Increment Discord and follow the developer on social media!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/XUXy8EWnaj]Increment Discord Server[/url]

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@pilpointzero]Tiktok: @pilpointzero[/url]

Thank you for checking out Increment!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and and Increment Discord Server
notes.notes:
Increment is very happy to be participating in Steam Next Fest this week! The demo is available now, and I'll be streaming mixed reality footage of a playthrough of that very demo. If you haven't played the demo already, check out the weird and wonderful first act of this experimental, incremental VR adventure!

If you're already intimate with the Increment demo, come and join the new [url=https://discord.gg/XUXy8EWnaj]Discord server[/url]!

notes.notes:
